start: An owner signed in to the panel of an online gym

steps.action: Open Money
user_sees: Two tabs: Collections and Dues
Collections opens first
must_not: Only the Dues tab shown to an owner

steps.action: Open Shop
user_sees: Two tabs: Orders and Products
must_not: The Products tab missing for an owner

steps.action: Open Expenses, Your growth, AI Assistant, Set up your gym and Settings, Branding from the menu
user_sees: Each page opens as usual
must_not: The 'Only an owner can see this' card shown to an owner
A menu entry missing for an owner

start: An owner with an old bookmark to the Shop messages address

steps.action: Open the old Shop, Messages link
user_sees: The page Messages & offers opens
must_not: The owner sent to Shop instead
A blank page for the old address

start: A gym kept in this browser only (no sign-in), or a device signed in with an old owner key that carries no person

steps.action: Open Money, then Expenses
user_sees: Collections and Dues tabs; Expenses opens
must_not: Staff limits applied because no person is known
The 'Only an owner can see this' card

steps.action: Take a payment
user_sees: The receipt saves; no name of a taker is forced
must_not: The save refused because nobody is signed in as a person

start: A shared desk computer: the owner is signed in, then signs out and a Staff person signs in

steps.action: As owner, open Money
user_sees: Collections and Dues
must_not: Dues only

steps.action: Sign out; the Staff person signs in on the same computer
user_sees: Today opens for the Staff person
The menu has no Expenses, Your growth, AI Assistant, Set up your gym or Branches
must_not: The owner's menu still showing
A money total left on screen from the owner

steps.action: The Staff person presses the browser back button
user_sees: An owner page shows 'Only an owner can see this', or Today
must_not: The owner page from before the sign-out drawn with its figures

steps.action: The owner signs in again
user_sees: Every page and both tabs are back
must_not: The owner kept on the Staff limits

start: An owner on Settings, Staff & sign-in

steps.action: Read the line about what Staff can do
user_sees: 'The owner can do everything. Staff (front desk) can add members, sell plans, collect fees, check members in, hand over shop orders and send members workout plans.'
'Staff cannot see money totals or expenses. They cannot cancel receipts, cancel or freeze plans, change plan prices or change gym details.'
must_not: A right named here that Staff do not really have, or a limit named here that the panel does not keep
Staff able to see a money total on any page although the line says they cannot

start: A Staff (front desk) person signed in to the panel

steps.action: Open Money
user_sees: One tab only: Dues, with the people to collect from
must_not: The Collections tab or any money total for the gym

steps.action: Open Shop
user_sees: One tab only: Orders
must_not: The Products tab, or a way to change a price

steps.action: Open the menu (sidebar, bottom bar and More)
user_sees: No Expenses, Your growth, AI Assistant, Set up your gym or Branches
Workout plans and Diet are there
must_not: A menu entry that leads to the owner-only card
Workout plans hidden from Staff

start: A Staff person with an old link or a typed address to an owner page

steps.action: Type the address of Expenses
user_sees: Card: 'Only an owner can see this'
'Ask your gym owner if you need something from here.'
Button 'Back to Today'
must_not: The Expenses page or any of its figures, even for a moment
A blank page

steps.action: Tap 'Back to Today'
user_sees: Today opens
must_not: The refusal card staying on screen
A sign-out

start: A Staff person with old links to the Money and Shop tabs and to Shop messages

steps.action: Open the address of Money, Collections
user_sees: Money opens on Dues
must_not: The Collections tab drawn
An error page

steps.action: Open the address of Shop, Products
user_sees: Shop opens on Orders
must_not: The Products list drawn

steps.action: Open the old Shop, Messages link
user_sees: Shop opens
must_not: Messages & offers opening for Staff

steps.action: Open the workout offer list and Automatic reminders by address
user_sees: Both pages open (the desk may look)
must_not: The 'Only an owner can see this' card on these two pages
A switch on Automatic reminders that Staff can change

start: A Staff person trying every owner page by address

steps.action: Open in turn: Settings Branding, Settings MettleUp plan, Branches, Money owed, Your growth, AI Assistant, Set up your gym, Get started, Messages & offers
user_sees: Each shows 'Only an owner can see this' with 'Back to Today'
must_not: Any one of these pages opening
A money total shown before the card appears

steps.action: Try to cancel a receipt, freeze a plan, change a plan price or remove an expense from a page Staff can open
user_sees: No button for it, or a plain refusal
must_not: The change saved under a Staff sign-in

start: A Staff person on the owner-only card

steps.action: Tap 'Back to Today', then press the browser back button
user_sees: The 'Only an owner can see this' card again
must_not: The owner page shown on the way back

steps.action: Reload the page on the owner address
user_sees: The same card
must_not: The page opening after a reload
A sign-out

steps.action: The owner makes this person an owner; the person signs in again
user_sees: Both Money tabs and every page
must_not: The Staff limits kept after signing in as an owner

start: A Staff person using only the pages Staff may open

steps.action: Open Today, Members, a member page, Money and Shop
user_sees: People, dues per person and orders
must_not: A total of money collected, an expense, or the month-by-month growth figures
The gym's MettleUp plan and what the owner pays

steps.action: Take a payment
user_sees: The receipt names this person as who took the money
must_not: A receipt with no taker, or with the owner as taker
